method: Actual source glyph mask threshold128. Three lines separated using y+x*tan(12deg), bands350/477px; minimum projected-height rectangle searched8..18deg in0.01deg increments. No photo or source mutation.

rows.rotation_note: Positive angle means line rises to the right in source, matching fitz text rotation angle. Angle from minimum ink-height rectangle is an approximation; hand-drawn letters do not share a perfect baseline.
